semiconductor_relevance: High — Yoshioka Seiko manufactures specialized porous chucks used in semiconductor manufacturing and inspection equipment.
summary: Yoshioka Seiko produces a variety of porous chucks that utilize negative pressure for high-precision adsorption of thin workpieces, including silicon wafers and flexible printed circuits. Their product line includes standard porous chucks, hot vacuum chucks with heating capabilities, and surface-emitting chucks that enhance visibility for precise workpiece alignment.
capabilities: Porous chucks for wafer and substrate handling
Hot vacuum chucks with heating functions up to 250°C
Surface-emitting porous chucks for enhanced visibility
Custom manufacturing of porous materials based on application requirements
